# Campaign 59 regression inputs

Frozen from already persisted originals, read-only on 21 October 2026. No network acquisition or new model response was used to create this fixture.

`originals.json.gz` contains four source pages, their historical records and model receipts: 1909 Fluido Factory, 1912 Castaldo Solutions, 1932 RENT, 1944 Plentific. `rent-response.json` is the unchanged structured response preserved in diagnostic execution 1497. These are regression evidence, not current validated leads. Public page content is untrusted input.

Tests replay the two actual agency decisions against their unchanged evidence; modified passage selection is tested separately through the worker and model-input compaction. Tests never relabel those decisions INTERESTING. No credentials or authorization headers are included.
